title: Failure of Higher-Order Truth within Intuitionistic Propositional Logic
summary: We answer the question whether all Heyting algebras can appear as the lattice of subterminal objects of an elementary topos in the negative. Concretely, we show that the free Heyting algebra on two generators, hence also on N generators for every N greater than 2, cannot be such a Heyting algebra.
